equity.level_reason: Racial and ethnic disparities in age-adjusted hospitalization rates are framed ('Disparities ... persisted'), quantified (1.4 and 1.3 times as high; 30%–40% higher) and interpreted as possibly decreasing since 2021–2022; the only explanation offered is a disparity in vaccination coverage, not a social or structural determinant.

level_alternative.reason: A racial and ethnic disparity in vaccination coverage is offered as a contributor to the hospitalization disparity; a reader treating unequal vaccine coverage as a structural determinant would reach 4.
